events.label: birth
events.text: Sabine Hossenfelder born; German author and theoretical physicist.
Completed undergraduate degree at Goethe-Universität Frankfurt.
Completed Masters thesis under Walter Greiner in Frankfurt.
Received doctorate at Goethe-Universität under Horst Stöcker.

evidence.quote: received her doctorate from the same institution in 2003

events.text: Postdoctoral researcher at GSI Darmstadt; stayed in Germany until 2004.

evidence.quote: remained in Germany until 2004 as a postdoctoral researcher

events.text: Began keeping a freelance popular science blog.

events.label: involvement
events.text: Became involved with the Experimental Search for Quantum Gravity conference series.

evidence.quote: Since 2007 she has been involved with the annual conference series

events.text: Joined Nordita Institute, Sweden, as Assistant Professor.

evidence.quote: She joined Nordita Institute for Theoretical Physics , Sweden , in 2009 as an Assistant Professor

events.text: Employed by Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies; leads Analog Systems group.

evidence.quote: She has been employed by the Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies since 2015

events.label: consulting
events.text: Offered paid physics consultation through her blog.

evidence.quote: act as a physics consultant on her blog

events.text: Created cards featuring pioneering quantum physicists.

evidence.quote: In 2017 she created cards featuring pioneering quantum physicists

events.text: Research Fellow at Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies.

evidence.quote: In 2018 she was a Research Fellow at the Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies

events.text: German edition Das hässliche Universum published.

evidence.quote: Her 2018 book , Lost in Math , was also published in German

events.text: Lost in Math published by Basic Books.

evidence.quote: Lost in Math : How Beauty Leads Physics Astray , Basic Books , June 2018

events.text: Co-authored Is Dark Matter Real? article in Scientific American.
